title: Add RAG templates, agent/tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Added RAG templates and agent tool-calling quickstarts to docs site; updates include example repos and runnable snippets for Python/TS SDKs.
description: This PR adds a set of opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) templates, agent/tool-calling examples, and corresponding quickstarts on the docs site. Motivation: provide engineers with end-to-end examples that show how to wire Redwood's retrieval layers, agent orchestration, and tool-calling APIs together for common workflows (customer support, code search, knowledge bases). Changes include: 1) a new /docs/quickstarts/rag directory with three guided quickstarts (Python SDK, TypeScript SDK, and a 'mini-app' example), 2) reusable RAG templates under /docs/templates/rag with configuration knobs for chunking, embedding model selection, and vector store adapters, 3) an agents examples folder with tool definitions and a sample tool-calling flow demonstrating function metadata, structured outputs, and safe fallbacks, 4) example unit/integration tests for the quickstarts so the docs-preview can validate snippets, and 5) updates to the docs sidebar and redirects so the new guides are discoverable. Checklist: - [x] Add Python and TS quickstarts with runnable snippets - [x] Add RAG template YAMLs and explanations - [x] Add agent/tool-calling examples and sample tools - [x] Add docs-preview tests and CI checks - [x] Add sidebar/docs-site navigation entries - [x] Add cross-links to SDK examples repos Related: ENG-2187, PM-462. Preview: https://deploy-preview-redwood-docs/internal/66321. Notes: kept code snippets small and runnable, prefer SDK v1.4 patterns (context managers for clients, streaming compatibility). No breaking changes to APIs. If reviewers want larger example apps extracted to redwood-examples we can open a follow-up PR to keep the docs repo lightweight.
